Apply the blueprint workspace onto a real draft.
If --ref does not exist a blank draft is created;
if it exists the workspace is treated as a diff edit.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --workspace TEXT:DIR REQUIRED 
                              Blueprint workspace directory.
          --ref TEXT REQUIRED Target draft reference, e.g. local://my_draft.
          --selection TEXT Excludes: --selection-file 
                              Inline Selection Expression ending in draft.apply().
          --selection-file TEXT:FILE Excludes: --selection 
                              File containing one Selection Expression program.
          --base-revision TEXT 
                              Expected canonical workspace revision. Rejects stale edits.
          --require-material-understanding 
                              Reject targets whose main image/video resources lack complete
                              material understanding metadata.
          --allow-existing-main-deletion 
                              Allow explicit Node Patch deletion or reassignment of existing
                              main segments.
          --allow-existing-subtitle-changes 
                              Allow deletion, start-time changes, and content changes of
                              existing subtitles. Protection is enabled by default. Other
                              validation remains active. Pass the same flag to plan and apply;
                              it is not persisted.
          --allow-segment-deletion 
                              Allow explicitly requested protected segment deletion when paired
                              with --delete-reason and --delete-target-id.
          --delete-reason TEXT 
                              Human-readable user reason for protected segment deletion.
          --allow-subtitle-delete-ids, --delete-target-id TEXT ... 
                              Existing subtitle segment id(s) allowed to be deleted.
          --disable-xmldraft-validation 
                              Disable XMLDraft validation for apply. Hard validation still
                              runs.
          --dir TEXT          Optional parent directory for the new draft project folder. Only
                              used when --ref does not exist; existing drafts keep their
                              registered path. Same semantics as draft project create --dir. PC
                              only.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint apply --workspace ./bp_ws --ref local://example
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint apply --workspace ./bp_ws --ref local://example --selection 'draft.select("#title content sub").attr("text", "New"); draft.apply();'
  $ lyra-cli draft blueprint apply --workspace ./bp_ws --ref local://example --selection-file ./edit.selection --dir ./outer

LEARN MORE
  Use this command to materialize a blueprint into a draft.
  Canonical XML time values are bare milliseconds without a unit suffix.
  Unit suffixes such as us, ms, s, min, or m are rejected.
  `--dir` is only used when the target draft does not exist yet.
  Relative transform fields require a VideoEditor runtime that registers `resolveRelativeLayout`; an older runtime fails explicitly instead of falling back to estimated geometry.
